title: The Inheritance of Saint Alder's
author: Bram Crane
blurb: Emrys Almeida, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
